name: auryn-events
summary: Language-agnostic message/event-bus stitch for Auryn: a post-ingestion hook that ties a publisher to a subscriber through the topic/queue they share (publisher -PUBLISHES_TO-> Topic <-SUBSCRIBES_TO- subscriber) across Kafka/RabbitMQ/NATS/Redis-style brokers -- a decoupled connection that has no call edge in the graph. Depends only on auryn-core.
